newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 25 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 25 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it qualified for insurance 25 bond issues slated for competitive sale today.
--Fairbanks North Star, Alaska, $16 million of general obligation (GO) bonds.
--Greenwood SD #25, Ariz., $8.3 million construction bonds.
--Milford, Conn., $10 million GO bonds.
--Manchester, Iowa, $2.2 million of GO corporate purpose bonds.
--Huntley Commission Consolidated SD, Ill., $7 million of school building bonds.
--Rockford Park, Ill., $3.2 million and $3.5 million of GO bonds.
--Fayette County SD, Ky., $14.7 million of revenue bonds.
--Manchester By-Sea, Mass., $8.5 million GO bonds.
--Canton Building Authority, Mich., $3.5 million of building authority bonds.
--Peck Comm. Schools, Mich., $3.2 million of GO bonds.
--Teconsha Comm. Schools, Mich., $1.5 million of GO bonds.
--Carteret County, N.C, $21 million of GO bonds.
--Union County, N.C., $26 million , $8 million and $3.2 million of GO bonds.
--Mandan, N.D., $1.6 million and $5.2 million of refunding and improvement bonds.
--Brookhaven, N.Y., $24 million of public improvement bonds.
--Orange County, N.Y., $10.6 million of various purpose bonds.
--Port Chester, N.Y., $1.9 million of public improvement bonds.
--Roosevelt UFSD, N.Y., $1.2 million of school district bonds.
--Stockbridge CSD, N.Y., $2.6 million and $640,000 of school district bonds.
--Riverside Beaver SD, Pa., $20 million of GO bonds.
--Pflugerville, Texas, $3 million GO bonds.
--West Harris MUD #9, Texas, $1.8 million of GO bonds.
--Viroqua, Wis., $3.6 million of GO corporate improvement bonds.
--Wisconsin $38 million of certificates of participation.
--Rupert, Vt., SD #47 $2 million GO bonds.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
